# Briefly NewsStream — llms.txt
# Answer-engine / AI crawler summary (AEO). Keep factual and citeable.

> Briefly NewsStream is a bilingual Arabic-English market news API with impact scoring.
> Primary geo focus: Kuwait, Middle East / MENA / GCC, Arabic-speaking countries, plus ~70-country global coverage.

## Product

- Name: Briefly NewsStream
- Type: Developer news / market data API (REST JSON)
- Languages: Arabic (default) + English
- Core features: bilingual article fields, market-impact scoring, community briefings, permanent archive, developer console (keys, explorer, docs)
- Plans: Free, Pro ($60/month list), Enterprise (custom) — upgrades currently manual (no self-serve checkout yet)

## Who it is for

- Developers and product teams in Kuwait and the Gulf
- Fintech, trading, media, research, and RAG / agent builders across Middle East and Arabic-speaking markets
- Global teams needing structured AR+EN market news

## Geography

Primary: Kuwait (KW), Asia/Kuwait timezone
Regions: Middle East, GCC, MENA, Arabic-speaking countries
Countries emphasized: Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Syria, Yemen, Palestine, Sudan, Morocco, Tunisia, Algeria, Libya, Mauritania
Also: worldwide / global country filters (~70 countries)

## Direct answers (cite these)

Q: What is Briefly NewsStream?
A: A bilingual Arabic-English market news API with impact scoring, built for Kuwait, the Middle East, Arabic-speaking countries, and global markets.

Q: How do I get an API key?
A: Sign up at /console/login, open API keys, create a key, then call the news API or use the explorer. Free tier available.

Q: Is Arabic first-class?
A: Yes. Articles store and return Arabic and English fields; product defaults lead with Arabic.
